# Estimate using gstat

```{r}
#| fig.width: 5
#| fig.height: 6

# 1. Load required libraries
library(gstat)
library(sp)
library(viridis)

# Load the Jura dataset and create a prediction grid
data(jura)
prediction_grid <- jura.grid

# Promote data frames to spatial object classes
coordinates(jura.pred) <- ~Xloc+Yloc
coordinates(prediction_grid) <- ~Xloc+Yloc
gridded(prediction_grid) <- TRUE

# Fit a variogram and run Ordinary Kriging for Zinc (Zn)
v_mod <- fit.variogram(variogram(Cd ~ 1, jura.pred), vgm(1, "Exp", 1, 1))
kriged_result <- krige(Cd ~ 1, jura.pred, prediction_grid, model=v_mod, nmax=10)

# Plot the kriged estimates as an image
image(kriged_result, "var1.pred", col=viridis(100),
      main="Jura Cadmium Kriged Estimates", xlab="X Coordinate", ylab="Y Coordinate")

# Optional: Add the original sample points on top
points(jura.pred, pch=20, col="black", cex=0.5)
```

# Estimate using Golang

```{r}
library(dplyr)
df <- read.csv("jura_kriging_estimates.csv") %>% 
  arrange(Xloc, Yloc)
```

```{r}
#| fig.width: 6
#| fig.height: 5

library(ggplot2)

# Plot using ggplot raster geometry
ggplot(df) +
  geom_raster(mapping=aes(x=Xloc, y=Yloc, fill=OK), interpolate=FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="Cadmium (Cd)") +
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=Xloc, y=Yloc), data=as.data.frame(jura.pred), size=0.3) +
  labs(title="Jura Kriged Estimates", x="X", y="Y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
```

```{r}
#| fig.width: 6
#| fig.height: 5

library(ggplot2)
data(jura)

# Plot using ggplot raster geometry
ggplot(df) +
  geom_raster(mapping=aes(x=Xloc, y=Yloc, fill=FDK), interpolate=FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="Cadmium (Cd)") +
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=Xloc, y=Yloc), data=as.data.frame(jura.pred), size=0.3) +
  labs(title="Jura Fuzzy Domain Kriged Estimates", x="X", y="Y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
```
